description: Cubic SrTiO3 perovskite GW (Dojo-NC-SR + matched TZDP basis, nspin=1).

basis_family.per_system_override_rule: Use the PseudoDojo NC-SR pseudopotential with the matched TZDP orbital set.
basis_family.rationale: The perovskite identity is frozen on the Dojo-NC-SR + matched TZDP basis; a mismatched PP/orbital pair corrupts EXX.

nao_family.rationale: The frozen reference uses the matched TZDP set.

exx_cs_inv_thr.per_system_override_rule: SrTiO3 is not heavy-element dominated, so the automatic Cs inverse cutoff is acceptable; tighten only if EXX looks wrong.
exx_cs_inv_thr.rationale: No strongly localized heavy 3d shell is present in the valence.

screening_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Use a regular Gamma-centred mesh matching the SCF run.
screening_kgrid.rationale: Screening definition must match the producer mesh.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: Use a moderately dense frequency grid for the oxide screening.
nfreq.rationale: Oxide screening converges more slowly than a simple semiconductor.

nbands.rationale: An incomplete state space corrupts EXX/GW.
